The Company anticipates releasing Part 1 data periodically throughout 2027.

The Company is supporting an investigator-initiated trial of oral epetraborole in M. abscessus and anticipates that data from this study, if positive, could provide clinical proof-of-concept in M. abscessus lung disease and thereby inform the design of a subsequent pivotal trial.
The Company anticipates reporting topline results in late 2027, subject to enrollment progress.
The Company plans to initiate a Phase 1 clinical study for AN2-504661 in the second half of 2027.
The Company projects that existing cash, cash equivalents, and investments will sustain operations into 2029 under the current operating plan.
